requirements: Ticket percentage and side from a licensed splits source before any RLM label
Steam Reversal uses only the owner's read-only Circa Google Sheet
The first unambiguous Circa move of at least 3.0 points is frozen
Pinnacle and BetOnline never substitute for the Circa Steam Reversal source
No sharp-money claim from line movement alone
The public fade label is held when material sourced availability overlaps the move
No alert when required inputs are absent or ambiguous

sharp_line_moves.definition: Observed Pinnacle spread movement from THI's first captured number. Public betting splits are unavailable, so this is not an RLM or sharp-money claim.
